model AgentPersonalization {
enum AgentPersonalizationMemoryChange {
  saved
  edited
  merged
  corrected
  capacity
  restored
  migrated
}

  preferredName      String                    @default("") @map("preferred_name") @db.VarChar(80)
  toolRules          Json                      @default("[]") @map("tool_rules")
  toolRuleTexts      Json                      @default("{}") @map("tool_rule_texts")
  revision     Int                             @default(1)
  activeSlot   Int?                            @map("active_slot")
  recoveryUntil DateTime?                      @map("recovery_until")
  pinned       Boolean                         @default(false)
  topic        String?                         @db.VarChar(40)
  lastChange   AgentPersonalizationMemoryChange @default(saved) @map("last_change")
  hitCount     Int                             @default(0) @map("hit_count")
  lastHitAt    DateTime?                       @map("last_hit_at")
  retrievals   AgentPersonalizationMemoryHit[]
  @@index([userId, updatedAt(sort: Desc), id(sort: Desc)])
  @@unique([userId, activeSlot])
}

model AgentSession {
}

model AgentPersonalizationMemoryHit {
  memoryId String                     @map("memory_id") @db.VarChar(64)
  memory   AgentPersonalizationMemory @relation(fields: [memoryId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  runId    String                     @map("run_id") @db.VarChar(64)
  run      AgentRun                   @relation(fields: [runId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@id([memoryId, runId])
  @@index([runId])
  @@map("agent_personalization_memory_hits")
  incomingChildGrant AgentChildExecutionGrant? @relation("ChildExecutionRun")
  personalizationMemoryHits AgentPersonalizationMemoryHit[]
candidate:
}

enum StoryMemoryLayer {
  itemCard
  locationCard
  sceneCard
  paragraphUnderlines  ParagraphUnderline[]
  profileChanges       StoryProfileChange[]
  content         String
  identityKey     String?            @map("identity_key") @db.VarChar(160)
  aliases         String[]           @default([])
  profileTracked  Boolean            @default(false) @map("profile_tracked")

  @@index([runId])
  @@index([novelId, memoryType])
  profileChanges  StoryProfileChange[]
  @@index([runId])
  @@index([novelId, memoryType])
  @@unique([novelId, memoryType, identityKey])
}

model MemoryEvidence {
}

model StoryProfileChange {
  id           BigInt             @id @default(autoincrement())
  memoryId     String             @map("memory_id") @db.VarChar(64)
  chapterId    String?            @map("chapter_id") @db.VarChar(64)
  section      String
  body         String?
  restricted   Boolean            @default(false)
  manual       Boolean            @default(false)
  knownBy      String[]           @default([]) @map("known_by")
  memory       ProjectMemoryEntry @relation(fields: [memoryId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  chapter      Chapter?           @relation(fields: [chapterId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([memoryId, id])
  @@index([chapterId])
  @@map("story_profile_changes")
